boxes.question: Is the post titled exactly “The Art of Wasting Time: Why True Productivity Isn't About Filling Every Minute”?
Does the post include personal anecdotes about failures in time management?
Does it discuss three distinct common efficiency myths and support them with neuroscience research?
Does it describe a transformative experience that was initially or seemingly unproductive?
Does it offer actionable strategies focused on energy cycles rather than only on scheduling time?
Does it include the requested “gardening your schedule” metaphor or a clear use of that metaphor?
Does it include data from Harvard Business Review about perfectionist scheduling?
Is the post conversational and self-deprecating, suited to overworked professionals aged 25–40 with time anxiety, and does it end with a discussion question about readers’ burnout experiences?
